## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Contract / compatibility

Describe any effect on model semantics, tensor shapes, causal behavior, public API, configuration, artifacts, or runtime compatibility. Write `none` if there is no contract change.

## Verification

List the exact commands, tests, static checks, benchmarks, or validation runs actually executed, including relevant results.

## Notes

Call out unresolved assumptions, follow-up work, or validation that remains outside this pull request.

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is scoped to the intended behavior.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Shared model/runtime changes were checked with the full pytest suite.
- [ ] Public API/config/artifact changes include compatibility review.
- [ ] Documentation describes implemented behavior without unsupported claims.
- [ ] Unverified assumptions or remaining risks are stated explicitly.
